name: count-up-spring
title: Count Up Spring
description: Numeric tween driven by a spring, not an easing curve: the displayed value overshoots the target and settles, digits use tabular numerals so widths never jitter, and re-targeting mid-flight re-targets the spring without restart.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Monospace
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Value Change Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
